Package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.model

Interface Deformer

All Known Subinterfaces:
RotationDeformer, WarpDeformer
public interface Deformer
One generation-bound Cubism deformer.

General relationship and evaluation reads are exposed independently of optional Editor authoring properties. Operations that edit visibility, locking, opacity, or color require a provider with verified Editor semantics; they must fail explicitly when unavailable instead of using evaluated/Core state as authoring truth.
